notes: Yahoo market/fundamental proxies plus the exact existing Rose-stored Yahoo TTF history; no Bloomberg, broker or account data used.
The TTF daily-history gap after July2 is not filled. Latest TTF quote is Nov4, but TTF beta samples end July2; scores are provisional.
Quote times, observation dates, annual periods, latest vendor quarter and release dates are distinct.
Primary issuer releases supplied separately verify selected results/distributions; they are not silently substituted into vendor scoring fields.
Legacy core-focus flags are research-universe labels, not statements about current account holdings.
price_adjustment: Yahoo auto_adjust=True; regular-session daily equity closes

FLNG.missing_component_treatment: No zero imputation; annual FCF and FCF/EV remain unavailable.

ttf_history_recovery.source: Existing project Rose object backed by Yahoo TTF=F
ttf_history_recovery.score_qualification: TTF-beta observations endJuly2 under the original180valid-observation rule; current scores must be labelled provisional.

methodology.only_formula_endpoint_refresh: YTD endpoint advanced from2026-04-24 to actual2026-11-04; named historical event windows retained.
methodology.growth: Uses the same Yahoo revenueGrowth field; this is not independently verified as a forward forecast.
methodology.stale_data: Universe retained; missing or over31calendar-day-old equity quotes are excluded from current scoring. No replacement ticker or price was inferred.
methodology.cashflow: Original latest-annual CFO plus signed capex formula, divided by current EV. Period dates shown; not TTM FCF or issuer DCF.

identity_events.treatment: Legacy row retained, no successor-price splice, excluded from current ranks.
Both rows retained; no completed-merger assumption.

distribution_data_note: Raw provider dividendYield is preserved as reported, not treated as a fractional yield or used in scoring. Displayed quarterly declared payments come from issuer releases; rates, record and pay dates are explicit.
source_field_note: Legacy field forward_revenue_growth_yf stores Yahoo revenueGrowth. Input and clipping unchanged; label corrected to reported vendor growth.
fx_conversion_note: Original TTF conversion: EUR/MWh times EURUSD divided by 3.412. Only FX is carried forward by the original calculation; TTF prices and missing TTF spread observations are never carried forward.

score_input_validity.headline_rule: Highest original score among current rows with all required finite fields. This is input completeness, not financial-quality approval; all TTF-based scores remain provisional.
score_input_validity.original_missingness_treatment: Raw invalid/missing ratios remain n/a. The unchanged scoring formula replaces missing factor z-score contributions with neutral zero; it does not impute raw prices, EV, EBITDA or capex. Missing-component scores are retained for transparency but excluded from the complete-input headline.
score_input_validity.ratio_sign_rules: EV and EBITDA must be positive for EV/EBITDA; EV must be positive for annual FCF/EV. Negative annual FCF is a valid negative yield, not cheapness. Net cash may produce a valid negative net-debt ratio with positive EBITDA.
